description: Public interface for configuring hardware interrupt levels in Zephyr RTOS, including function typedefs, inline functions for enabling/disabling IRQs, and API structure definitions.

methods.name: irq_enable_next_level
methods.description: Enables an IRQ in the next level of interrupt controller.

methods.name: irq_disable_next_level
methods.description: Disables an IRQ in the next level of interrupt controller.

methods.name: irq_is_enabled_next_level
methods.description: Checks if any IRQs are enabled in the next level.

methods.name: irq_set_priority_next_level
methods.description: Sets the priority for a specific IRQ in the next level.

methods.name: irq_line_is_enabled_next_level
methods.description: Checks if a specific IRQ line is enabled.
